assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production game sprite atlas for The Stellar Holds, a charming painted top-down 2D dwarf game. Reference image is ONLY identity/style reference for Lord Eirik Granitecrown: old masculine broad sturdy adult dwarf, white swept hair and full three-plait white beard covering chin, gold crown teal diamond, teal gold-trimmed robe, dark brown fur mantle and heavy boots. Generate one transparent atlas with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of full-body poses, each centered in an equal cell with generous transparent margins. Consistent scale, orthographic elevated three-quarter/top-down gameplay camera looking down 35 degrees, no perspective scene. Row1 four DISTINCT forward/down-facing WALK keys: left contact, right passing with lifted boot, right contact, left passing. Row2 same four keys facing screen right. Row3 same four keys facing away/up (back cloak and crown, no face). Row4: standing idle facing down; crouched halfway sitting down facing down with hands reaching toward armrests BUT NO chair; properly seated facing down knees bent feet forward hands resting on knees BUT NO chair; seated slight forward lean talking with one open hand BUT NO chair. Every sprite includes entire head crown body hands robe and boots in a single complete painting. Do not draw thrones or furniture. No text, numbers, grid lines, shadows outside silhouettes, weapons, extra limbs or background. Keep modest adult head proportions, squat powerful body, clear walking foot changes. Match reference clothing/face faithfully, detailed painted shading but readable at 65px high.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original production prop atlas for an illustrated top-down 2D dwarf mountain-hold game. Match reference image's grey carved stone, restrained gold brass knotwork and teal cushions. Reference is style only; NO characters in output. Transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated architectural props in a 2 by 2 equal-cell atlas, fully separated, no cropped edges. Top-left: EMPTY monumental Dwarven throne, high stepped back with carved ancestral dwarf faces and gold geometric knot inlay, teal padded seat, broad squared armrests, short stone footrest, no person. Top-right: tall massive square load-bearing hall pillar with broad stepped capital and octagonal plinth, carved geometric bands, slate grey warm highlights, height about twice width. Bottom-left: majestic carved wall relief of three ancient crowned Dwarf ancestors emerging from a broad stone lintel, teal hanging banner on either side, a gold central mountain-and-star crest; wide and symmetrical, no freestanding living people. Bottom-right: tall sturdy bronze brazier on a squat carved stone pedestal, amber fire burning in bowl, small warm glow confined to flame. All viewed orthographically from elevated 35-degree top-down angle, fronts facing screen down, symmetrical front elevation with visible top planes, NOT diamond isometric. Painted textured game art with clear dark outlines and readable forms, no text, no numbers, no grid, no surrounding floor, no room background, no shadow rectangles.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original environment texture for The Stellar Holds, a painted 2D top-down dwarf mountain city. Generate an edge-to-edge continuous massive dark grey blue mountain bedrock wall, irregular interlocking angular rock strata, broad stone shelves and natural vertical fissures, layered cliff faces viewed from elevated 35-degree orthographic camera. It must read as solid underground mountain surrounding carved inhabited terraces, NOT sky, floating island, clouds, abyss, landscape horizon or building. Warm illustrated painterly game style, restrained texture, strong readable rock planes and crevices, muted slate and charcoal with occasional warm mineral seams, soft upper-left light. No text, characters, plants, objects, architecture or border. Uniformly useful across entire image, no central focal object. Landscape 3:2 composition, high quality game background texture.
